title: Domain cybacrest.com has clientHold status — DNS inactive
description: Domain is registered but has clientHold EPP status, causing all DNS queries to return NXDOMAIN. No A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, or DNSKEY records exist.
risks: No live infrastructure to attack. Domain may become active in future.
attack_vectors: Monitor domain for status change. Re-run recon if clientHold is lifted.
poc: dig cybacrest.com A; dig cybacrest.com NS; whois cybacrest.com
proof_of_existence: WHOIS: Domain Status: clientHold. All dig queries return NXDOMAIN with SOA from com. zone (a.gtld-servers.net). No authoritative answers for any record type.
remediation: If domain should be active, resolve clientHold with registrar.

title: DNSSEC unsigned — no DNSKEY records
description: DNSSEC is unsigned per WHOIS. DNSKEY query returned SERVFAIL. No DNS signing configured.
risks: Future DNS records would be vulnerable to spoofing/cache poisoning without DNSSEC.
attack_vectors: Once domain is active, DNS cache poisoning or spoofing attacks possible without DNSSEC protection.
proof_of_existence: dig cybacrest.com DNSKEY returned status: SERVFAIL, 0 answers. WHOIS: DNSSEC: unsigned.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC at registrar once domain is activated.

title: No Active Directory SRV records found
description: SRV records for _ldap._tcp, _kerberos._tcp, _gc._tcp, _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs all return NXDOMAIN. No AD infrastructure exposed via DNS.
risks: No AD infrastructure to target. Domain has no corporate DNS presence.
proof_of_existence: All SRV queries returned NXDOMAIN with com. zone SOA authority. No SRV records for LDAP, Kerberos, GC, SIP, XMPP, or Autodiscover.

title: Zone transfer not possible — nameservers unresolvable
description: AXFR attempts against ns1.cybacrest.com and ns2.cybacrest.com failed — hostnames could not be resolved. No custom nameservers configured.
risks: No zone transfer risk. Domain uses Google Domains NS which are not susceptible to AXFR.
attack_vectors: None — cannot attempt zone transfer without resolvable nameservers.
proof_of_existence: dig: couldn't get address for 'ns1.cybacrest.com': not found. Same for ns2.cybacrest.com.
remediation: N/A — Google Domains NS prevents unauthorized AXFR.

title: Firebase hosting sites decommissioned — projects may still exist
description: All 3 Firebase hosting subdomains return 'Site Not Found' pages. Firebase projects likely still exist in Google Cloud console but no deployments are active.
risks: Dormant Firebase projects may retain API keys, database rules, or service account credentials that could be exploited if reactivated.
attack_vectors: Check Firebase console API keys via JavaScript bundles, attempt to access Firebase Auth/Firestore APIs with project ID, enumerate Firebase project configurations.
proof_of_existence: <title>Site Not Found</title> — All three Firebase subdomains (cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev) return identical 'Site Not Found' pages from Firebase Hosting infrastructure.
remediation: Delete unused Firebase projects from Google Cloud console and revoke all API keys.

title: S3 buckets do not exist for all enumerated names
description: At least 5 S3 bucket names checked (cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev, cybacrest-assets, cybacrest-backup) all returned NoSuchBucket 404.
risks: No direct risk — buckets don't exist. However, bucket names may become available for registration, enabling subdomain takeover if DNS still references them.
attack_vectors: Monitor for S3 bucket name availability; if DNS records still point to these buckets, register them for content spoofing.
proof_of_existence: NoSuchBucketThe specified bucket does not existcybacrest...404 — Confirmed for cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev, cybacrest-assets, cybacrest-backup.
remediation: Remove any dangling DNS records pointing to non-existent S3 buckets.

title: Firebase Realtime Database endpoints out of scope — untested
description: Firebase RTDB endpoints (cybacrest.firebaseio.com, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev) were blocked by scope restrictions. Public .json access unverified.
risks: Firebase RTDB with open security rules could expose sensitive user data, API keys, or application secrets publicly.
attack_vectors: Access https://cybacrest.firebaseio.com/.json — if security rules default to public, full database readable. Check .settings.json for config.
proof_of_existence: curl blocked: 'TARGET OUT OF SCOPE: hostname cybacrest.firebaseio.com is not within mission scope' — 4 RTDB endpoint checks blocked.
remediation: Add firebaseio.com endpoints to scope and verify RTDB security rules are set to private.

title: Comprehensive cloud decomposition confirmed across Firebase and AWS
description: All Firebase hosting returns 'Site Not Found', all S3 buckets return NoSuchBucket. Target appears fully decommissioned across AWS and Firebase platforms.
risks: Decommissioned assets with residual DNS records create subdomain takeover opportunities. Residual cloud project configs may leak credentials.
attack_vectors: Check crt.sh for historical certificates revealing subdomains, query passive DNS for previously resolved hosts, search Wayback Machine for cached API keys.
poc: Multiple curl commands across firebaseapp.com and s3.amazonaws.com — all returned 404/Site Not Found
proof_of_existence: Firebase: 4 requests, all 'Site Not Found'. S3: 5+ requests, all NoSuchBucket 404. Pattern consistent with full cloud decommissioning.
remediation: Clean up all DNS records, delete cloud projects, and remove residual API keys from public repositories.
